# Accessible form and state recovery

An activity coordinator needs a usable registration form. Implement labelled fields, keyboard errors, waiting, failure, retry and cancellation when input changes.

## Input and contract
input/fixture.json; input/dictionary.md; project version 1

## Finding and reproducible output
```json
[
  {
    "id": "empty",
    "state": "required",
    "retained": ""
  },
  {
    "id": "format",
    "state": "format",
    "retained": "bad"
  },
  {
    "id": "success",
    "state": "success",
    "retained": "a@example.invalid"
  },
  {
    "id": "failure",
    "state": "failed",
    "retained": "b@example.invalid"
  },
  {
    "id": "edited",
    "state": "cancelled",
    "retained": "new@example.invalid"
  },
  {
    "id": "timeout",
    "state": "retry",
    "retained": "c@example.invalid"
  }
]
```

## Failure prevented
A late response must not overwrite an edited input or clear it after failure.

## Decision and limits
Accept only the specified result set. Escalate a missing identity, permission, business probe or required not-run item. This is an original synthetic teaching reference, not evidence of learner execution or real employment.
